stem: A parking lot has 7 rows with the same number of spaces in each row, plus 4 additional spaces next to the entrance. The lot has 116 spaces in total. How many spaces are in each row?
solution: Let \(n\) be the number of spaces in each row: \(7n + 4 = 116\).
verify:
n = symbols('n')
sol = solve(Eq(7*n + 4, 116), n)
assert sol == [16]
assert [Rational(a) for a in spr_answers] == sol
